text: Battery is charged and strapped in
Wires are tucked away from wheels and moving parts
Drive motors all spin the right way (forward, strafe, turn)
Pinpoint reads a sensible x, y and heading when you push the robot
Auto runs once from the starting spot without hitting anything
Flywheel reaches ready speed and holds it
Feeder pushes one ball and stops
Claw / servo presets open and close fully
Limelight connects and sees a tag
Webcam shows the Hive tag in the camera preview
Status LEDs show the right state
Logging is on and a fresh log file appears after a short run
